editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Saxo Bank is a DFSA-licensed Danish bank scoring 8.2/10 from NAFT in 2026. Six regulatory licences, 72,000+ instruments (the widest in the industry), institutional-grade SaxoTrader platforms, and banking-level deposit protection. 65% retail loss rate — one of the lowest. Best for sophisticated multi-asset traders and investors wanting a banking-grade platform with unmatched instrument range.
